def check(candidate):
    import pandas as pd

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([1, 2, 3, 4]),
        pd.Series([3, 4, 5, 6])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([1, 1, 2, 2, 3]),
        pd.Series([1, 2, 2, 4])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([10, 20, 30]),
        pd.Series([40, 50, 60])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series([1, None, 3, 3]),
        pd.Series([None, 3, 4])
    ))

    print(candidate(
        pd.Series(dtype=float),
        pd.Series(dtype=float)
    ))
